title: Graduation Flower Card
tagline: Customizable interactive graduation flower card with playful quiz, typewriter message, and 8 switchable 3D/2D/SVG flower bouquets (vanilla HTML/CSS/JS).
problem: A small interactive graduation card you can personalise and send as a link. The visitor answers two playful questions, gets a "Congratulations" with confetti, reads your typed message, and finally sees a bouquet bloom, drawn entirely in code.
solution: It is plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript: no framework, no build step, no images for the flowers. Edit one file, upload the folder, and share the link.
highlights: Sound effects: eight short CC0 clips (a paper page turn, soft chimes, a pop when the wrong answer runs away) with one corner volume control. Try them on the sound board.
Optional background song: off by default. Add your own MP3 and it fades in quietly after the first tap.
Fits every screen: tested from 320 px phones to wide desktops, portrait and landscape.

title: Appointly
tagline: Flutter appointment manager with recurring schedules, client views, local reminders, and JSON backup.
problem: A Flutter mobile application for managing appointments, recurring schedules, and client details with local device storage.
solution: Appointly combines a calendar, appointment history, and client views in one application. Users can create a booking, choose a reminder, reuse contact details, and export appointment records as JSON.
highlights: Calendar and booking form: client name, phone number, location/notes, date, optional time, and editing controls.
Recurring schedules: one-time, weekly, and monthly appointments, with controls to delete one occurrence or the entire series and undo a deletion.
Local persistence: Hive CE stores appointments and settings; Provider connects database changes to the UI.

title: BetterNotes
tagline: Colorful sticky notes for Windows, web, and mobile. Flutter app with rich text, images, reminders, backups, and optional Google/Supabase sync.
problem: Colorful sticky notes that stay with you across devices.
solution: A cross-platform notes app built with Flutter, designed as a richer replacement for Windows Sticky Notes. It works fully offline and can optionally sync through Google sign-in.
highlights: Desktop sticky notes. Each note gets its own movable, resizable window on Windows. Windows remember their position, can stay on top, and reopen where you left them.
Rich text editing. Headings, lists, checklists, quotes, inline code, text and highlight colors, font sizes, links, find-in-note, and full undo/redo.
Images and ink. Paste screenshots straight from the clipboard, place images inline, and draw with a mouse, touch, or stylus. Images are compressed automatically.

title: Hujan
tagline: A self-hosted Discord companion for Windows. One bot gives your server an AI assistant with a personality you choose, rain and sleep ambience for voice channels, and consent-gated voice summaries transcribed on your own machine.
problem: A self-hosted Discord companion for Windows. One bot gives your server an AI assistant with a personality you choose, rain and sleep ambience for voice channels, and consent-gated voice summaries transcribed on your own machine.
solution: 1. Open <http://127.0.0.1:3210> and enter the one-time access code printed in the terminal.
highlights: Sleep ambience. /sleep join mode:rain|sunny|silent streams rain, sunny birdsong and distant thunder into a voice channel from local audio files.
Windows desktop app. Electron app with a tray icon, Start/Stop, protected settings and a bundled Node runtime.
Local dashboard. Owner-only web UI at 127.0.0.1 for settings, ambience, commands and health.

title: Monitor Remote
tagline: Windows monitor control, remote screen viewing, touch mouse and keyboard input, and PC audio device volume control.
problem: A Windows desktop companion that turns iPhone Safari into a local PC controller.
solution: View a selected Windows display, control the mouse with touch, type from your phone, and adjust playback or microphone endpoint volume. External-monitor brightness and all-display off/wake controls are also available. A Windows Forms launcher manages the server, QR pairing, permissions and tray controls; the phone uses plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript without a native app or cloud service.
highlights: Allow screen viewing: the phone's Desktop tab can list and view a selected display.
Allow mouse and keyboard control: permits touch and typing after screen viewing is enabled. The phone separately selects Enable control.
Allow audio volume control: enables Audio, independently of screen sharing.

title: MathFunEducation
tagline: FunMath: Unity mathematics lessons, quizzes, minigames, and Vuforia image-target AR activities.
solution: ▶ Play the web demo on itch.io · 🎬 Watch the 40-second trailer · 📱 Download the Android app (APK)
highlights: Built for small children, in two languages. Malay and English text and voice-over, with a friendly owl guide, big buttons and a parent area behind a maths question.
Maths you can touch. Besides lessons and quizzes, kids play a rocket game, balance scales and a directional "algorithm" puzzle that teaches sequencing.
AR on the phone. Eleven Vuforia image-target lessons let children see addition, time, perimeter, area and volume on real objects.

title: Virtual Lab
tagline: Unity science-learning project with guided experiments, object interactions, quizzes, and account/results integration.

gallery.caption: Guided 3D virtual biology lab experiment scene
Module selection and interactive lesson menu
Interactive anatomy inspection and nutrition quiz

problem: A Unity science-learning application with Malay-language activities, interactive laboratory sequences, quizzes, and results review.
solution: Virtual Lab brings lesson content and practical interactions into a scene-based learning experience. Its activities include digestive-system identification, a carbohydrate food-sample experiment, and food-pyramid/healthy-plate tasks. The project combines object selection and dragging, animation-driven instructions, answer evaluation, and a PHP-backed account and score flow.
highlights: A structured activity collection: 49 enabled scenes, comprising seven menu/account scenes and 42 scenes grouped under Aktiviti1 through Aktiviti8.
Interactive lab sequences: raycast-based selection, object dragging, collision checks, and animation states guide experiment steps.
Different answer interactions: text input, multiple-choice buttons, and drag/drop matching support quizzes and results activities.

title: HzSwitcher
tagline: Windows tray app for monitor refresh rate and brightness
problem: A small Windows tray app for switching a monitor's refresh rate and brightness, with an automatic power-saver that drops the rate when you are idle or watching video.
solution: Version 1.8.0. Windows 10 or 11, x64. Built with C# on .NET 10 (Windows Forms). The release exe is self-contained, so no .NET install is needed.
highlights: Presets: named one-click rates. Defaults are Gaming (highest), Balanced (120 Hz) and Battery saver (60 Hz). If the monitor doesn't support a rate, the nearest one is used.
Pause automation: pause saver and app profiles together for 15 minutes, 1 hour, or until restart. Manual controls remain available, and saved enable switches stay unchanged.
Brightness: a slider in the tray menu and on the Display page. Each monitor remembers its own level, and the power-saver can lower brightness too (see below).

title: Hopboard
tagline: Share text between your own devices over local Wi-Fi. No account, no cloud. Paired with a six-digit code, encrypted and certificate-pinned. Flutter for Windows and Android.

gallery.caption: Hopboard main Windows & mobile pairing overview
Instant copy-and-paste transfer across local devices
Android mobile client receiving synced clipboard items

problem: Copy on one device. Paste on another. Nothing leaves your Wi-Fi.
highlights: Connections: TLS 1.2+ with certificate pinning, length-limited messages, and per-device rate limits.
Discovery: devices find each other with mDNS, but discovery is never trusted on its own; the pinned certificate decides.
Clipboard privacy: copies that password managers mark as private are never sent automatically.

title: Unity Subscription Unlock
tagline: Unity subscription integration prototype for unlocking game content, with account flows and hosted Stripe-related payment pages.
problem: Use the existing LogMasuk and LamanUtama scenes for registration, login, profile and subscription menus. The included PHP backend owns authentication, email verification and Stripe billing; Unity presents its results and gates local premium actions.
solution: Start with setup. It covers offline checks, server preparation, Unity settings and the online test sequence. The backend URL is intentionally empty until configured.
highlights: Public GitHub repository written primarily in C#.
Includes source code and documentation on GitHub.

title: Talentlink Job Portal Demo
tagline: TalentLink: offline Flutter job & talent management demo (fictional data)
problem: A Flutter job and talent management app that runs entirely offline on
solution: fictional sample data. TalentLink is a portfolio demo: it is not affiliated with
highlights: Register and sign in with a local account, or use the sample login
Save jobs, apply, withdraw, and simulate interview invitations and offers.
Enrol in training or webinars; sessions appear in the calendar.

title: Evergreen Ai Virtual Lab
tagline: Malay-language 2D STEM virtual lab in Unity: drag-and-drop experiments, quizzes and an OpenAI-powered science tutor, built with Claude Code + Unity MCP.
problem: A 2D Unity virtual science lab for secondary-school students, written in Bahasa Malaysia (KPS curriculum). Students work through guided lessons, run drag-and-drop lab experiments, test themselves with quizzes, and ask an AI science tutor questions at any point.
solution: A Windows 64-bit pre-release build is on the Releases page. Unzip it, keep all files together, and run Evergreen.exe. The downloaded build uses the tutor's scripted demo answers and never calls OpenAI.
highlights: Built on the OpenAI-Unity package (Assets/Samples/OpenAI Unity/0.2.2/ChatGPT/ChatGPT.cs).
Context-aware system prompts: the assistant picks a prompt per screen (Dashboard, Akt1–Akt7, MM3–MM7) so answers stay on the topic the student is studying.
Scoped behaviour: the tutor answers only science questions and stays in character as a scientist.
